title: FY2017 Section 5310 Enhanced Mobility of Seniors and Individuals with Disabilities grant application
source_representation: scan-only PDF; indexed/visually reviewed, full OCR pending staged extraction
purpose: Enhanced Mobility of Seniors and Individuals with Disabilities Program (5310), State Fiscal Year 2017.
compliance_evidence: Application checklist includes financial/managerial capability, Title VI minorities-served information, nondiscrimination assurance, operating certificates, preventive-maintenance documentation, legal name, local match/operating-fund evidence, and status of open 5310/5317 projects.

Assurance package includes Section 504 certification, procurement information certification, standard assurances, local civil-rights assurance, school-bus operations certification, federally required/model contract clauses, incidental-services certification, authorizing resolution, equivalent-service certification, charter certification, disability assurance, lobbying certification, milestones, project financing/local-match commitment and coordinated-plan requirements.

The standard assurances address civil-rights/Title VI compliance, equivalent service for disabled riders, fair opportunity for private transit operators, procurement requirements, Buy America and fiscal/managerial capability.
provenance_note: Claims are based on the FY2017 application checklist and assurance pages visible in the supplied scanned source; do not treat as current grant requirements.
